objective: Make agent planning, check selection, provenance and closeout repeatable across this ASHYQ repository
acceptance: New non-ledger changes require scoped task plans
Changed domains imply declared checks and reviews
Existing full CI remains intact and SEO is actually executed
Future agents find the operating contract from AGENTS and README
counterexamples: An unrelated scoring edit must fail scope coverage
A stale success report must fail after source changes
A failed or timed-out command must not count as success
The local runner must reject remote network-check targets and arbitrary shell commands
